title: Ethiopian Chicken and Egg Stew
community: All of Ethiopia — the egg-enriched everyday chicken stew
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Chicken and Egg Stew — a simplified everyday Doro Wat with chicken and boiled eggs simmered together in a berbere sauce. The everyday version of the national dish — eggs extending the meal and adding additional complete protein.
longDesc: Doro Inqiilal is the daily reminder of Doro Wat — a simplified version where the everyday cook uses fewer ingredients but maintains the essential elements: berbere sauce, chicken, and the all-important whole eggs. The eggs absorb the sauce and become as prized as the chicken.
steps: Add kibbeh and berbere. Toast 3 minutes.
Add garlic and ginger. Add chicken. Coat in sauce.
Add pierced eggs. Simmer 15 more minutes.
chefTips: Pierce eggs with a skewer — deeper than you think.
Even 15 minutes in the sauce turns the eggs distinctly orange.
commonMistakes: Short cooking — eggs should be orange throughout.
sustainabilityTips: Eggs extend the protein of a smaller chicken quantity.
healthBenefits: Complete protein from both chicken and eggs.
Very high iron from berbere and chicken.
culturalNote: Doro Inqiilal keeps the spirit of Doro Wat alive every day — the whole egg in berbere sauce is the most unmistakably Ethiopian element of the national dish, and this everyday version ensures it is accessible whenever needed.
